_source: UHV-A1 (docs/eras/uhv.md, 'A1. Transcurium' and 'Older machines, new modes'): the HFIR driver row of IV's fuel fabrication plant. Real process: HFIR's involute fuel plates, a fissile oxide in an aluminium cermet core roll-bonded in aluminium cladding (ORNL); here the fissile charge is UV's uranium-233.
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/iv/uranium_cycle.js after the steps of uranium_cycle.json and thorium_fabrication.json; the same format (itemsIn, fluidsIn, fluidsKept, fluidsOut, itemsOut). Circuit 7: 1-3 are IV's, 4-6 UV's.
energy: one IV assembler stage (1,536,000 EU, as the LEU assembly), spent at the plant's maxEUt like every other row.

Destination: the driver elements go to UHV's high flux reactor (tables/transcurium.json); the spent ones to UV's pyroprocessing cell (tables/transcurium_pyroprocessing.json), which gives the uranium-233 back.

energy.stage: oxidising the metal, pressing the U3O8-aluminium cermet cores and roll-bonding the involute plates in aluminium: one IV assembler stage
